mostWorthwhile.text: Following the rocky fragments into dust and seeing that dust mingle with material from warming ice tied the chapter's two paths together.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the inward-bound icy bodies was useful, but the partner list alone was less engaging than seeing what the encounters did.

surprise.text: The icy impacts could deliver water, but the result qualified how much a world might retain; that was less straightforward than simple delivery.

arbitrary.text: The inspection automatically combined the rocky fragments with warm space; the connection to collisions between stones was not obvious to me beforehand.

continue.text: Yes. I would choose another chapter to follow more of these connected material histories, especially when separate paths meet again.
